subject: social
title: Rules and Laws
about: Why we have rules at home, at school and in the community, and that laws are rules everyone in a town, state or country must follow. NC 1.C&G.1.2: how people help make rules and laws.
tip: Ask him to name one rule at home and say in his own words why it helps.

cards.a: to keep everyone safe and fair
cards.note: Rules help people stay safe and treat each other fairly.

cards.q: What do we call rules that everyone in a town, state or country must follow?
cards.note: A law is a rule for everyone, made by the government.

cards.q: Who helps make the rules for your classroom?
cards.note: Many classes talk together and agree on their rules.

cards.q: Who makes the rules at home?
cards.note: Families make rules so everyone at home stays safe and gets along.

cards.q: Every driver must stop at a red light. What do we call a rule like that?
cards.note: Traffic rules are laws. Every driver must follow them.
Laws are for everyone, kids and grown-ups alike.

cards.q: Why do we wear a seat belt in the car?
cards.note: A seat belt holds you in your seat if the car stops fast.

cards.q: A fair rule is the same for which people?
cards.note: Fair means the rule is the same for every person.

cards.q: Why do we raise a hand before talking in class?
cards.note: Taking turns lets everyone be heard.

cards.q: Why do we walk, not run, in the hallway?
cards.note: Walking keeps everyone in the hallway safe.

cards.q: You break a rule and lose a turn. What is losing the turn called?
cards.note: A consequence is what happens after you break a rule.

cards.q: Why do kids need a grown-up with them at the pool?
cards.a: to stay safe in the water
cards.note: Pools have a rule that a grown-up watches kids in the water.

cards.q: Why is there a rule to wash hands before eating?
cards.note: Soap and water wash germs off your hands.

cards.q: Who must stop at a stop sign?
cards.note: Stopping at a stop sign is a law. Every driver must stop.

cards.q: Rules help us get along and stay what?
cards.note: Good rules keep people safe and help them get along.

cards.q: What do the rules of a game tell players?
cards.note: Game rules make sure every player plays the same way.
